en_title: Sony Confirms PlayStation Plus Monthly Games for August 2026, Headlined by Dying Light 2: Stay Human
cn_title: 索尼公布8月PlayStation Plus会免：《消逝的光芒2》领衔
subtitle: 月度阵容揭晓
opus_summary: 索尼公布8月PS+会免阵容：8月4日至31日可领取《消逝的光芒2：重装上阵版》、合作冒险游戏《Big Walk》及《Signalis》。另有《Marvel Tōkon》头像与姿势礼包，8月6日起向订阅者开放一年。

paragraphs.en: Sony has confirmed the PlayStation Plus monthly games lineup for August 2026 — and it includes Dying Light 2: Stay Human: Reloaded Edition, plus a bonus Marvel Tōkon pack.
paragraphs.cn: 索尼已确认2026年8月的PlayStation Plus月度游戏阵容，其中包括《消逝的光芒2：重装上阵版》，以及额外的《Marvel Tōkon》礼包。

paragraphs.en: Available on both PS4 and PS5, Dying Light 2: Stay Human is the post-apocalyptic zombie survival sequel with top-notch parkour and an awesome open world. You play as Aiden Caldwell, a wanderer with the power to change the fate of The City — and also boot zombies off the top of skyscrapers. You don't have to do it all alone, either, as there's the choice of up to four-player co-op.
paragraphs.cn: 《消逝的光芒2：重装上阵版》可在PS4和PS5上游玩，是一部拥有顶尖跑酷和出色开放世界的后末日僵尸生存续作。你将扮演能够改变The City命运的流浪者Aiden Caldwell，也能把僵尸从摩天大楼顶端一脚踹下去。你也不必独自完成这一切，因为游戏可选择最多4人合作。

paragraphs.en: "No patch can fix the forgettable main plot or the protagonist I couldn’t pick out of a police lineup even after 80 hours in his shoes, but Dying Light 2’s streets tell their own stories," we wrote in IGN's Dying Light 2: Stay Human review , awarding the game a 7/10.
paragraphs.cn: 我们在IGN的《消逝的光芒2：重装上阵版》评测中写道：「再多补丁也修不好令人过目即忘的主线剧情，也救不了那个即便让我操控80小时、放进警方列队里我也认不出的主角；但《消逝的光芒2》的街道自会讲述自己的故事。」我们给这款游戏打出了7/10分。

paragraphs.en: Two other titles join August's monthly game additions, which all become available to subscribers from next Tuesday, August 4, until Monday, August 31.
paragraphs.cn: 另有两款作品加入8月月度游戏阵容；它们都将从下周二8月4日起向订阅者开放领取，至周一8月31日结束。

paragraphs.en: Next up is Big Walk, from the creators of indie hit Untitled Goose Game. This cooperative multiplayer adventure is all about teamwork and talking, and sees you and your friends exploring a peaceful and picturesque world full of challenges, puzzles and discoveries.
paragraphs.cn: 接下来是独立热门作品《鹅作剧》开发者制作的《Big Walk》。这款合作多人冒险游戏围绕团队协作与沟通展开，你和朋友将在一个宁静优美、充满挑战、谜题与发现的世界中探索。

paragraphs.en: Finally, there's Signalis, a classic psychological survival horror experience drenched in melancholic mystery. Investigate a dark secret, solve puzzles, fight off nightmarish creatures and navigate dystopian, surreal retrotech worlds.
paragraphs.cn: 最后是《Signalis》，一款笼罩在忧郁神秘氛围中的经典心理生存恐怖体验。调查一个黑暗秘密、解开谜题、击退梦魇般的生物，并穿行于反乌托邦、超现实的复古科技世界。

paragraphs.en: But wait — there's more! Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls fans should take note of an incoming PlayStation Plus Pack available from August 6. This add-on, available via the PlayStation Store, will contain five avatars inspired by Captain America, Storm, Spider-Man, Doctor Doom, and Ghost Rider, plus a set of in-game Result Screen Character Poses featuring 20 characters, including Spider-Man, Ms. Marvel, Star-Lord, Peni Parker and more. There's no rush to grab the pack, either, as it'll be available to Plus subscribers for 12 months.
paragraphs.cn: 但等等——还有更多内容！《Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls》粉丝应留意将于8月6日上线的PlayStation Plus礼包。这款可通过PlayStation Store获取的附加内容将包含以Captain America、Storm、蜘蛛侠、毁灭博士和Ghost Rider为灵感的5个头像，以及一套涵盖20名角色的游戏内结算画面角色姿势，其中包括蜘蛛侠、Ms. Marvel、Star-Lord、Peni Parker等。也不必急着领取：该礼包将向Plus订阅者开放12个月。
